## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL, internal rotation across sectors. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive (Internal Rotation). Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); confirmed by mixed sector returns and balanced top-performer mix.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.92% | 1M: +30.67%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: PM (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology lagging: LRCX (1W: -7.02% | 1M: -18.02%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: CAT (1W: -7.04% | 1M: -9.42%) BELOW TREND. Communication under pressure: NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND; ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND; ROST (1W: +7.44% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND; PM (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +8.29%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5) — breadth mixed but multiple sector winners.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: IBM (1W: -26.61% | 1M: -18.81%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -13.25% | 1M: -12.19%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -11.34%) BELOW TREND; C (1W: -8.52% | 1M: -10.47%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech and cap‑goods names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +23.58%) ABOVE TREND. Note ACN (1W: +4.48% | 1M: -6.11%) in RECOVERY — short-term bounce vs medium-term weakness.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech is soft and showing internal rotation. NVDA (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -3.24%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +23.58%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth: 6/24 positive (effectively weak within Tech).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials steady with selective strength. PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +9.14%) ABOVE TREND — sector breadth: 11/20 positive (internal rotation supporting Financials).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed with pockets of strength and correction. ABT (1W: +11.16% | 1M: +15.69%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.76% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -3.47% | 1M: +6.24%) CORRECTION — sector breadth: 8/17 positive (internal rotation).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor exposure to Energy and select Financials and Consumer Staples given current rotation; reduce exposure to structurally weak Tech names showing confirmed BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy and Financials leading while Tech softens.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND; MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (sector breadth positive; MPC/VLO/PSX above trend). BEARISH: Technology (broad weakness across semis and software; multiple large-cap Tech names BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA 600 resistance as a failure/resume pivot for Tech (NVDA (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -0.67%) BELOW TREND). AAPL 180 support for continued ABOVE TREND momentum (AAPL (1W: +2.92% | 1M: +10.35%) ABOVE TREND). JPM 200 breakout would confirm Financials follow‑through (JPM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
PYPL (+55): PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price confirming strong accumulation. V (+50): V (1W: +0.79% | 1M: +9.14%) ABOVE TREND — news on stablecoin platform confirms steady upside. UNH (+55): UNH (1W: -1.76% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines but short‑term drift suggests partial divergence to monitor.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
ORCL (-60): ORCL (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -33.63%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirming distribution and structural weakness. NFLX (-40): NFLX (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -12.16%) BELOW TREND — sentiment aligns with earnings weakness and price pressure. PFE (-45): PFE (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -4.51%) RECOVERY — legal headlines negative while price shows short‑term strength, a divergence to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical tilt.  
PYPL (1W: +19.24% | 1M: +35.03%) ABOVE TREND and Energy names like MPC (1W: +6.21% | 1M: +28.90%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is Tech deterioration and select news‑driven divergences (ORCL and NFLX confirming weakness; PFE and UNH show headline/price divergence).
